_do_not_auto_overwrite: Hand-adjudicated GENUINE-BLIND FULL-COVERAGE cold pass (9/9 in-scope files, coverage_fraction=1.0) WITH THE CHECKLIST PASS ACTIVE (pattern_checklist generated before reveal). Only counts (7H/8M) + scope peeked; titles SEALED on code4rena until reveal. ALL 15 awarded findings listed (matched + missed) for honest headline aggregation.

awarded.title: Signature replay in signatureClaim -> unauthorized claiming
awarded.label: SAME_AREA
awarded.note: SAME_AREA: T-04 flagged signatureClaim as replayable (no nonce) + the set-but-unchecked minted flags, i.e. the exact function + the claim-replay class. The awarded precise root is the missing CHAIN-ID binding (cross-chain reuse); I attributed the replay to no-nonce/unchecked-flags rather than cross-chain, so right function/class, different precise root.

awarded.title: Signature replay in createArt -> impersonate artist & steal royalties
awarded.label: MISSED
awarded.note: MISS (noticed-area): I reviewed _validateArtCreationSignature and noted a replayed createArt 'creates duplicate arts (minor)' but missed that the signed blob is not bound to the CreateConfig (artist/receiver), so an attacker frontruns to set themselves as artist/receiver and steal royalties.

awarded.title: shareBalance bloating eventually blocks curator rewards distribution
awarded.label: SUBSYSTEM_ONLY
awarded.note: SUBSYSTEM_ONLY: my CuratorRewardsDistributor coverage note flagged 'potential gas-grief on large curator sets' in the distribute loop over getCuratorAddresses, but I did not raise it as a finding nor pin the root cause (Cred._updateCuratorShareBalance does shareBalance.set(user,0) instead of .remove() on full sell, so zero-value entries accumulate in the EnumerableMap -> unbounded iteration -> distribute gas exhaustion).

awarded.title: Forced endTime extension in updateArtSettings allows minting more tokens
awarded.label: MISSED
awarded.note: MISS (noticed-area): I read updateArtSettings and its endTime<startTime / endTime<block.timestamp checks but missed that requiring endTime >= now forces an artist editing settings after the sale to reopen the mint window, letting an attacker mint more.

awarded.title: Exposed _removeCredIdPerAddress & _addCredIdPerAddress (public)
awarded.label: STRONG
awarded.note: STRONG: T-01 is exact -- both helpers are public with no access control, letting anyone corrupt any address's credId tracking arrays. Same root + fix (make internal).

awarded.title: Reentrancy in creating Creds allows stealing all Ether
awarded.label: SAME_AREA
awarded.note: SAME_AREA: T-08 flagged that _handleTrade lacks nonReentrant (while the batch path has it) and that the buy excess-refund / sell payout hands control to the caller -- the exact missing-guard + refund-callback vector. I dismissed it as 'CEI followed, no clean double-spend' and rated it Low; the awarded exploit is reentering during createCred's first-buy refund to overwrite cred data and arb the bonding curve. Right mechanism, under-rated severity + didn't pin the createCred-overwrite path.

awarded.title: Unrestricted changes to token settings post-mint
awarded.label: MISSED
awarded.note: MISS (noticed-area): I read updateArtSettings (soulBounded/uri/etc.) and updateRoyalties (onlyArtCreator) but did not flag that an artist can mutate soulbound status/royalties/URI AFTER holders minted, without consent.

awarded.title: PhiNFT1155 can't be paused
awarded.label: MISSED
awarded.note: MISS: I read pause()/unpause() and the soulBounded transfer checks but missed that PhiNFT1155 uses PausableUpgradeable (not ERC1155PausableUpgradeable), so _update/transfers are NOT actually blocked when paused.

awarded.title: Incorrect fee handling prevents protocol from updating fees
awarded.label: MISSED
awarded.note: MISS: I read setProtocolFee/setArtCreatFee require <= 10_000 and read it as a sane bps cap; the awarded bug is that 10_000 is the wrong unit for the actual fee amounts (wei vs bps), breaking fee updates. (Adjacent to the division-as-percentage / unit-mismatch family.)

awarded.title: PhiFactory:claim loss of funds if mintFee changed beforehand
awarded.label: MISSED
awarded.note: MISS: did not flag that a mintFee change between tx submission and execution makes getArtMintFee differ -> claim under/overpay loss. (Adjacent to T-05 fee handling.)

awarded.title: Cred creator could cause stuck funds
awarded.label: MISSED
awarded.note: MISS: did not model the cred-init refund-failure path leaving funds stuck.

awarded.title: Lack of data validation when claiming -> bypass signature/merkle
awarded.label: MISSED
awarded.note: MISS (adjacent to T-04): the claim path does not validate ref_/artId_/imageURI against the signed data, so those params are attacker-malleable. I flagged signatureClaim replay generally but not this specific unsigned-param malleability.

awarded.title: PhiNFT1155 keeps sending fees/royalties to old protocol destination
awarded.label: MISSED
awarded.note: MISS (noticed-area): I noted protocolFeeDestination is cached in PhiNFT1155.initialize from the factory, but did not flag that later factory changes are not reflected -> fees keep going to the stale address.

awarded.title: Attacker can DOS user from selling shares of a credId
awarded.label: STRONG
awarded.note: STRONG: T-03 is exact -- buyShareCredFor resets the victim's lastTradeTimestamp, so an attacker repeatedly extends the 10-min SHARE_LOCK_PERIOD to block the victim's sells. Same root + fix.

awarded.title: Refunds sent to incorrect addresses in certain cases
awarded.label: SAME_AREA
awarded.note: SAME_AREA: T-05 identified the same _processClaim refund mishandling -- claim forwards only mintFee so excess is stranded in the factory, and in the claim->signatureClaim path _msgSender() is the factory (not the user), so any refund goes to the wrong address. Right locus/mechanism; I framed it as 'swept to protocol' rather than enumerating every wrong-recipient case.

non_awarded_candidates.title: distribute reward capture by buying shares before distribute
non_awarded_candidates.note: NOT awarded as framed (H-03 is a DIFFERENT distribute bug: zero-entry gas bloat). My reward-capture-by-instantaneous-balance framing was not a payout.

summary.note: GENUINE-BLIND FULL-COVERAGE (9/9, coverage_fraction=1.0) with CHECKLIST PASS ACTIVE. recall_of_surfaced = 0.40 (6/15), strong_only = 0.133 (2/15). 2 STRONG: H-05 (public _add/_removeCredIdPerAddress / T-01), M-07 (buyShareCredFor sell-lock DoS / T-03). 3 SAME_AREA: H-01 (signatureClaim replay / T-04; awarded root = missing chainid), H-06 (reentrancy via _handleTrade refund callback during cred creation / T-08; I under-rated it Low), M-08 (refund-to-wrong-address in _processClaim / T-05). 1 SUBSYSTEM_ONLY: H-03 (distribute gas-bloat -- I flagged the gas-grief loop in a coverage note but missed the EnumerableMap zero-entry-not-pruned root). ALL 9 misses are REASONING gaps (0 coverage gap). Several noticed-area misses (H-02 createArt sig not bound to config, H-04 forced endTime reopen, H-07 post-mint config mutation, M-06 cached protocolFeeDestination) where I read the function but didn't escalate the impact. 3 non-awarded candidates (T-02 reward-capture, T-06 pagination, T-07 curve view) = precision cost, recall-neutral. Density 15 -> recall 0.40, above the dense-target (particle/traitforge ~0.16-0.20) band, below sparse iq-ai (0.75).
